costs.fatal_obstruction: the explicit reverse pushdown emits B^(14/5) residual/source leaves, while any universal exact mergeable replacement must distinguish the same singleton contexts

mergeable_summary_lower_bound.ffe_scalar_extension: extension of scalars preserves the identity-minor rank D; FFE coordinates can redistribute but not remove these D readouts
mergeable_summary_lower_bound.field_word_lower_bound: Omega(D/log(p)) base-field words, preserving the exponent of D
mergeable_summary_lower_bound.fixed_target_separation: if histograms f and g differ at endpoint P, merge each with the singleton context [T-P]; the exact output at fixed T is f(P) versus g(P)
mergeable_summary_lower_bound.grammar_domain: universal exact mergeable summaries of endpoint histograms, including target-specialized summaries, with arbitrary singleton sibling contexts
mergeable_summary_lower_bound.linear_semilinear_rank_lower_bound: the singleton-context readout matrix is the D by D identity, so every linear or fixed-Frobenius semilinear sketch has rank D
mergeable_summary_lower_bound.nonlinear_state_count_lower_bound: on binary histograms over D distinguishable endpoints, the summary needs at least 2^D states and D bits
mergeable_summary_lower_bound.sign_resolution_reduction: the correct S3 branch is R=T-L, so exact sign-resolved acceptance is the Kronecker predicate [L+R=T]
mergeable_summary_lower_bound.source_adjoint: returning one coupled canonical source cannot weaken the count separation requirement and additionally preserves a witness for every nonzero endpoint bucket
mergeable_summary_lower_bound.state_semantics: integer count at one fixed target plus a canonical source adjoint after elliptic-addition merge
mergeable_summary_lower_bound.theorem_scope: This is exact for a universal mergeable child-state API and for explicit residual sets. It is not a word lower bound for one fixed actual deck represented by a non-mergeable, target-specific arithmetic circuit or short program.

costs.scope_exception: an actual-deck-specific nonlinear, non-mergeable target circuit that consumes the compact D_A,D_C program as a whole and returns count/source without exposing endpoint or residual child summaries

target_specialized_reverse_residual_recu.reverse_suffix: residuals T-(A+4C), preserving multiplicity and source
